title: Bifactor Statistical Indices — bifactor_indices
text: model must bifactor structure one general factor loading items plus orthogonal specific factors. Standardized loadings used. general loadings \(g_i\), specific loadings \(s_i\) errors \(e_i = 1 - g_i^2 - s_i^2\): ECV = \(\sum g_i^2 / \sum (g_i^2 + s_i^2)\). omega_H = \((\sum g_i)^2 / Var_{total}\), omega         adds grouped specific variance numerator. omega_HS (per specific factor) = \((\sum s_i)^2 / Var_{sub}\). H = \(1/(1 + 1/\sum (\lambda_i^2/(1-\lambda_i^2)))\). PUC = proportion item correlations items         different specific factors. IECV_i = \(g_i^2 / (g_i^2 + s_i^2)\) (item purity toward G).

text: Iteration logic. Fit EFA using package's internal EFA engine current item set (oblique rotation default). Extract loading matrix \(L\) factor correlation matrix \(\Phi\) (identity unavailable). Derive communalities \(h^2 = \mathrm{diag}(L \Phi L')\) uniquenesses \(\psi = 1 - h^2\). Flag: Heywood (\(\psi < -\)heywood\_tol impossible loadings), near-Heywood (\(\psi\) within [-near\_heywood, near\_heywood]), salient loading (\(|loading| <\) loading), cross-loadings (2+ salient loadings; severity scored gap two largest absolute loadings). Enforce min_items_per_factor using primary (largest absolute) loading; rows salient loading count toward factor. Removal policy (priority order): Remove severe Heywood item. Else remove worst near-Heywood item. Else, RMSEA exceeds thresholds$rmsea, simulate single-item removals (preserve min\_items\_per\_factor) drop candidate yielding best RMSEA improvement. Else remove structurally worst item (diagnostic score). Stop RMSEA \(\le\) threshold factors meet min\_items\_per\_factor, admissible removal improves fit/structure, maximum number steps reached.
